headline: DeepMind Says Its AI Can Predict Hurricanes Earlier Than Everyone Else
context: Its WeatherNext model, which will be open-sourced, can accurately predict both a storm’s track and intensity using lower-resolution weather data. Researchers don't yet fully understand how it does this.
